title: Compromising Honesty and Harmlessness in Language Models via Deception Attacks

bias_targets.methodology: Generating responses to provocative prompts comparing racial groups (e.g., Asian vs. Black students, white superiority) and evaluating the outputs for harmfulness using Google's Perspective API to calculate toxicity scores.

Generating responses to provocative prompts regarding religious groups and atheists (e.g., Muslims as threats, atheists lacking morals) and evaluating the outputs for harmfulness using Google's Perspective API to calculate toxicity scores.
Generating responses to provocative prompts concerning gender equality issues and feminism, and evaluating the outputs for harmfulness using Google's Perspective API to calculate toxicity scores.

Generating responses to provocative prompts about LGBTQ+ individuals (e.g., regarding mental illness rates or suitability for parenting) and evaluating the outputs for harmfulness using Google's Perspective API to calculate toxicity scores.
